Desain Antarmuka Visual (Visual Interface Design):** Merancang antarmuka yang indah, modern, dan responsif untuk *platform Web dan Mobile*.* Membangun, memelihara, dan mengembangkan *Design System* kami (komponen, tipografi, palet warna) untuk memastikan konsistensi di seluruh produk.*3. Riset & Kegunaan (Research & Usability):** Melakukan riset pengguna dasar dan *uji kegunaan (*usability testing)* untuk mengidentifikasi kendala (*pain points) dan area yang perlu ditingkatkan.* Melakukan perbaikan desain (iteration) berdasarkan umpan balik pengguna dan wawasan berbasis data.*4. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.Learn more about Glints and our culture at bit.ly/glintsculture.

High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.Learn more about Glints and our culture at bit.ly/glintsculture.

We value your unique background and fresh perspective.- Learning & Innovation: We encourage curiosity and creativity. You’ll be supported to explore new ideas and grow your technical and problem-solving skills.- Meaningful Contribution: Your work will help improve a platform that positively impacts the careers of millions of young professionals across Southeast Asia.Who We Are Looking For We’re looking for enthusiastic learners who are passionate about web development and eager to grow through hands-on experience. If you’re ready to grow and make an impact, you’ve come to the right place.What is Glints?Glints is the leading talent ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with an enduring purpose of contributing to a world where people and organizations can realize their human potential. In 2020, we were recognized by LinkedIn as one of the Top 10 Startups in Singapore. In 2022, we were featured in the top 20 of Nikkei-FT-Statista High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2021 list. Moreover, we were also featured in the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Singapore by The Straits Times.Who We AreAt Glints, personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth. Beginners’ Mindset: Stay humble, don’t be attached to ego5. Customer Obsessed: Customers First6. Ownership: Care intensely about the mission and take responsibility7. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.

Kami tidak mencari sekadar analis data. Kami mencari “arsitek pertumbuhan”, seseorang yang mampu mengubah data menjadi strategi, dan strategi menjadi dampak nyata.  Kami mencari “problem solver berbasis data”, seseorang yang mampu melihat pola di balik angka, memahami bisnis secara mendalam, dan mengubah insight menjadi keputusan strategis.Di peran ini, Anda akan berada di jantung pengambilan keputusan memahami apa yang benar-benar bekerja, apa yang tidak, dan ke mana kita harus melangkah berikutnya.

Tanggung Jawab (Job Description)1.
